comparison.objective: Extract a connector terminal, versus scribe a shelf profile against an uneven wall.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed blade insertion and pulling, versus maintaining compass contact while tracing a constrained path with the other hand supporting the shelf.
comparison.success_condition: Selected terminal exits intact; versus an accurate continuous scribe at prescribed stations and compass put down clear.
comparison.reason: The record tests contact-following and geometric transfer rather than latch extraction.
